description: Corrections to the identity of sheet-derived venues: the name, trust, position or storey that data/mapped-sites.json got wrong. The drafter (scripts/nhs/draft-sheets.mjs) names a sheet after the ODS record it matched, and ODS files departments, closed sites and legacy trusts as sites — so a John Radcliffe map arrived under the Nuffield Orthopaedic Centre trust, a St George's map on Woking, and Southport's on the closed town-centre infirmary. scripts/maps/sheets.mjs lays these entries over the drafted ones every time the sheets are read, so a --force re-draft cannot undo a correction a person has checked; scripts/maps/apply-identity.mjs writes the same corrections into the committed venue modules and into mapped-sites.json, which is how they reach the app without the source PDFs.
howToAdd: Only record what you have checked against the trust's own website, the NHS ODS register or the sheet's own title, and say which in `evidence`, dated in `checked`. `center` is [lat, lng]. `spanM` is the full sheet width in metres and is only needed when the drafted scale came from the wrong hospital's footprint — it is an estimate until someone checks the drawing against the map. `floor` re-storeys a single-sheet venue whose sheet is one level of a building; `floorNaming` goes with it when the trust numbers its levels from something other than the ground.

sgh-site-map.name: St George's Hospital, Tooting — Grounds & Car Parks
sgh-site-map.subtitle: St George's University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust · Blackshaw Road, London SW17 0QT
sgh-site-map.notes: Site map published by St George's University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (2013). Identity and position corrected September 2026: the sheet draws the Tooting site, not Woking. Placed on the centre and scale of the hand-built St George's venue; the drawing itself has not been checked by eye.
sgh-site-map.evidence: The sheet's labels are the Tooting site (Atkinson Morley Wing, St James Wing, Cavell and Gunning wards); the trust has no hospital in Woking. It was drafted against ODS D3X3Z 'St Georges at Woking Hospital', a community service the trust runs there. Centre and scale from src/lib/venues/st-georges.ts, the verified venue of the same site, which this sheet complements with the grounds and car parks.

pinderfields-hospital-map.name: Pinderfields Hospital
pinderfields-hospital-map.subtitle: Mid Yorkshire Teaching NHS Trust · Aberford Road, Wakefield WF1 4DG
pinderfields-hospital-map.notes: Site map published by Mid Yorkshire Teaching NHS Trust. Position corrected September 2026: the sheet was matched to the Dewsbury record and sat ten miles west of the hospital it draws; now centred on Pinderfields, Aberford Road. Scale is the drafted estimate and has not been checked by eye.
pinderfields-hospital-map.evidence: Sheet titled 'Pinderfields Hospital'; drafted against ODS P6M3A (Dewsbury & District). The trust gives Aberford Road, Wakefield WF1 4DG; ODS site RR864 'Pinderfields General Hospital' geocodes to 53.692434, -1.488558, 140 m from the centre used and inside the site.

community-diagnostic-centre-site-map.name: Wakefield Community Diagnostic Centre
community-diagnostic-centre-site-map.subtitle: Mid Yorkshire Teaching NHS Trust · Westgate Retail Park, Ings Road, Wakefield WF2 9SD
community-diagnostic-centre-site-map.notes: Plan of Westgate Retail Park published by Mid Yorkshire Teaching NHS Trust, showing where the Community Diagnostic Centre (Unit 9B) sits among the retail units. Position corrected September 2026 to the WF2 9SD postcode; the drawing has not been checked by eye, and the centre's own unit is not labelled on it.
community-diagnostic-centre-site-map.evidence: The sheet's labels are Westgate Retail Park's tenants (Wickes, Currys, Next, Smyths, Pets at Home) and its title block names Unit 9B; the trust's page for the centre gives Westgate Retail Park, Ings Road, Wakefield WF2 9SD. Drafted against ODS P6M3A (Dewsbury & District), the trust's elective hub. Centre is the postcode centroid.

level-3-floorplan-cuh-map.name: Addenbrooke's Hospital — Level 3
level-3-floorplan-cuh-map.subtitle: Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust · Hills Road, Cambridge CB2 0QQ
level-3-floorplan-cuh-map.notes: Level 3 floor plan published by Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. Identity corrected September 2026: this is a level of Addenbrooke's, not Doddington Hospital. Placed on the Addenbrooke's venue centre; scale is the drafted estimate and has not been checked by eye.
level-3-floorplan-cuh-map.evidence: The trust publishes Level_3_Floorplan_-_CUH_Map.pdf as a floor of Addenbrooke's, and its labels (Clinic 4a, Clinic 12, ward A3, fluoroscopy, DXA) are Addenbrooke's Level 3. Drafted against ODS B5D1I 'Cuh at Doddington Hospital', a community hospital thirty miles away. Centre and level numbering from src/lib/venues/cuh.ts.

pilgrim-ground-floor.subtitle: United Lincolnshire Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust · Sibsey Road, Boston PE21 9QS
pilgrim-ground-floor.notes: Ground floor plan published by United Lincolnshire Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust. Placement is derived automatically (centre from the NHS ODS register, scale estimated) and has not been checked by eye.
pilgrim-ground-floor.evidence: ODS holds the trust's departments at this site as separate records ('Pilgrim A&E', 'Pilgrim Surgery') and the drafter took the first; the sheet is the ground floor of the whole hospital.

lister-map-2026.notes: Site map published by East and North Hertfordshire Teaching NHS Trust (2026). Placement is derived automatically (centre from the NHS ODS register, scale estimated) and has not been checked by eye.

southport-hospital-site-map-a3-sept-2024.name: Southport and Formby District General Hospital
southport-hospital-site-map-a3-sept-2024.subtitle: Mersey and West Lancashire Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust · Town Lane, Southport PR8 6PN
southport-hospital-site-map-a3-sept-2024.notes: Site map published by Mersey and West Lancashire Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust (September 2024). Position corrected September 2026: the sheet was matched to the closed Southport General Infirmary in the town centre; now centred on the District General Hospital at Town Lane (NHS ODS register). Scale is estimated and has not been checked by eye.
southport-hospital-site-map-a3-sept-2024.evidence: Drafted against ODS RVY03 'Southport General Infirmary' (PR8 6PH), a closed town-centre site, with a scale measured from that building's footprint. The hospital the sheet draws is ODS RVY01 'Southport & Formby District General Hospital', Town Lane PR8 6PN, 53.63357, -2.978821. Southport and Ormskirk Hospital NHS Trust became part of Mersey and West Lancashire Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust on 1 July 2023.

princess-anne-hospital.evidence: The ODS site record R1C36 is Solent NHS Trust's (a community service on the site); the Princess Anne is University Hospital Southampton's, which published the plans (uhs.nhs.uk).

hull-royal-infirmary-site-map.subtitle: Hull University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust · Anlaby Road, Hull HU3 2JZ
hull-royal-infirmary-site-map.notes: Site map published by Hull University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust (April 2024). Position corrected September 2026: the sheet was matched to an ODS record in HU4 and sat 2.4 km west of the infirmary; now centred on the Anlaby Road site (NHS ODS register). Scale is the drafted default and has not been checked by eye.
hull-royal-infirmary-site-map.evidence: Drafted against ODS A7G4P (postcode HU4 6BN), which is not the infirmary. Hull Royal Infirmary is Anlaby Road, Hull HU3 2JZ (CQC location RWA01, nhs.uk, Wikipedia); ODS site RR860 'Hull Royal Infirmary' geocodes to 53.744134, -0.358153, within 25 m of the Google Maps place pin (53.7441816, -0.3584076). The trust's site map at /wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Hull-Royal-Infirmary-Site-Map.pdf is still the one it links.
